# Amendment No. 1 to Acme Analytics MSA

## Amendment Identity

Amendment ID: AMD-ACME-2026-01

Related Agreement: MSA-ACME-2026

Effective Date: 2026-04-15

The Customer and Provider agree that this amendment controls over conflicting terms in the Master Services Agreement.

## Statement of Work 7 Exit Change

For Statement of Work 7 only, the Customer's convenience termination notice period is increased from 60 days to 90 days.

No additional Provider termination-for-convenience right is added by this amendment.

## Data Security Liability Cap

For claims arising from a Provider data security breach, the Provider's aggregate liability cap is increased to two times the fees paid or payable under the affected statement of work during the twelve months before the event giving rise to the claim.

This data security cap does not limit confidentiality breach claims, indemnification obligations, or intentional misconduct.

## AI Use Restriction

The Provider may not use Customer Data to train generalized artificial intelligence models, analytics models, or benchmarking products.

This restriction applies even if the Customer Data has been aggregated or de-identified.
